title: Staff Backend Engineer (Go)
description: As Staff Backend Engineer you will own the architecture of our core Go services that power a distributed, multi-region platform. You will set technical direction for latency, consistency, and reliability, working across service boundaries with gRPC and event-driven messaging. You will design schemas and migration strategies on PostgreSQL, and drive the adoption of Kubernetes and Terraform for delivery at scale. Mentoring senior and mid-level engineers, championing observability practices, and participating in the on-call rotation are core parts of this role.
